subject: wo-exp-pri
title: WO.EXP.PRI.----INFO.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 453 (MP(I)-27). WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) is the subject; INFO-DY (information dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications), SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) and MT-INTR (multiple interpretation). From T-C-IMP: INFO-TRNS (information transference) and DOC (documentation). From SPT-DY: IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics). From MT-INTR: AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From INFO-TRNS: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From AF-DY: POST (postulation).
